label: Typed inputs and outputs for a solver tool
section: Typed inputs and outputs for a solver tool
subgoals: Define each input field with a type and an explicit unit
Key every output by stable net or node names
Expose existing modes as parameters rather than code

label: What the tool must report besides the answer
section: What the tool must report besides the answer
subgoals: Return an error estimate and the discretization used
Flag inputs outside the calibrated validity range
Report convergence failures as structured errors

label: Batching and determinism
subgoals: Accept many nets per call to amortize setup
Take and record a seed for any randomized step
Run the tool sandboxed with no network access
